name: Muskan Foundation for people with multiple Disabilities
description: Muskan Foundation’s association with MDVI children started as early as February 2007, under the leadership of Dr. Dipti Gandhi who perpetuated a new lease of life for children with multiple disabilities. The main objective of this venture was to bridge the gap in schools and education centers, which are usually not equipped to handle multiple disabilities along with blindness. Muskan Foundation aims to provide a spectrum of customized services ranging from early intervention, education, therapy, counseling and MDVI awareness. The foundation commenced its work with a small group of 4 children, which has swelled to 123 students in 6 centers and more than 200 children receiving regular therapy.

name: HWCT India Foundation - Human Welfare Charitable Trust
description: HWCT INDIA FOUNDATION is a Public Charitable Trust, Non-Profit, Charitable Organization, established in 2015 with the primary goal of reaching out to support the weaker economic sections of the society. HWCT focuses on Education, Skill Development amongst children, youth and women in Mumbai & Rural Maharashtra. HWCT is working by supporting over 17 schools and shelter at Naigaon with the integration of the right education system implementation program, skills programs, enabling the children to lay their foundation of a progressive future. We leverage our long-standing partnerships, dedicated schools,and skill resources to build community-driven solutions, spark life-changing innovations and elevate ideas with the help of individuals.

featured_reviews.name: Adarsh Chaubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
We can never find words big enough to thank the incredible team who has stood by us throughout this journey, supporting our family medically, emotionally, and practically. We are deeply grateful to Naina Kanal ma'am for her phenomenal guidance and leadership, and to Dr. Shivam Shingla for his exceptional knowledge, kindness, and for always being accessible when we needed him most. Along with Dr. Pallavi, Dr. Pooja, Dr. Tanvi, and the wonderful nursing staff at Global Cancer Care, their genuine empathy and dedicated care are the reasons our dad is doing much better today.
Alongside our medical team, a major pillar of our strength has been the selfless support from the PMK Foundation (Pahile Majhe Kartavya Foundation). When we were navigating the overwhelming complexities of cancer care, their team stepped in with true compassion, helping us manage critical logistics and easing our burdens. They do not just provide aid; they treat you like family and ensure that no patient fights this battle alone.
This journey has shown us the true power of collective kindness.
The seamless harmony between the life-saving medical care of Dr. Shivam, Naina ma'am, and team, and the noble on-ground support of the PMK Foundation, has given our father a second lease on life. We will forever remain indebted to each one of you for your dedication, humanity, and blessings.

featured_reviews.name: Aayush Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: I volunteered with PMK Foundation and it was a very fulfilling experience. The team is dedicated, friendly, and focused on helping the community. Their initiatives for children and social welfare are truly inspiring. Highly appreciate their efforts. I had a great experience working with PMK Foundation. Proud to be associated with such a meaningful initiative

featured_reviews.name: Dipesh Khairwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
During a very challenging time for our family, PMK Foundation stood by us and made the entire treatment process much easier and more manageable. Their guidance, emotional support, and timely help gave us strength and hope when we needed it the most.

Mrs. Nayna Kanal is a truly compassionate and dedicated person. Her kindness and commitment to helping cancer patients and their families is inspiring. She supported us like a family member, and we are deeply thankful for her efforts.

Because of PMK Foundation, my mother was able to receive proper treatment with dignity and comfort. We are forever grateful for their presence in our journey.

Thank you, PMK Foundation and Mrs. Nayna Kanal, for being a blessing to our family.
